body:
M41-8 (backlog Re-plan row 3): **F4** next-goal strip label + **F3 = UX-M4** ★ Best buy chip (built once, citing both IDs). New branch off `main` dd223f510e9acabf9b1915b56e39da8b88dcac63. The D-HOP-42 `Farm L{n}: unlocks {Track} L{m}` variant (F4-20..25) is **not** built because it depends on L30+.

DO NOT MERGE without CCR + QA verdict + green CI (CI is down account-wide; local gates below are interim evidence). HoE merges.

Sources:
- `art-ux/f4-next-goal-label.md` (LOCKED 10:10 + D-HOP-32)
- `product/farm/frozen/m4a-spec.v1.24.md` §18, sha256 `38e95a5d…94e9`
- `art-ux/m4.1-ui-minors.md` UX-M4
- `art-ux/reviews/m4-on-checklist.md` F3

### Change
- **`src/ui/goal-label.ts` (new, pure):**
  - Templates:
    - Milestone level: `★ {Track} L{n}: {milestone}`. Milestone levels come from config. An Egg value grade counts only once its Farm gate is met.
    - Any other Hens / Egg value level: `★ {Track} L{n} · +X% income`.
    - Collection: `★ Collection L{n}: +{Δtap}/tap`. It never shows a % part.
  - **X:** `floor(100 × gain / base + 1e-9)`. `gain` is best_roi's own `optionGain(s,b,key).gain` and `base` is `incomePerSec(s,b,{assumeWorking})`, so there is no second income calculation.
    - 0 < delta < 1 shows `+<1%`.
    - delta ≤ 0, or income now = 0, hides the part.
  - **Spacing:** a NBSP before `L{n}` and on either side of `·`.
  - **Truncation** (while over 27 code points): drop `★ `, then use the short name (`Value` / `Coll.`), then put `…` on the name. The level and suffix are never cut.
  - **Aria** is untruncated: `best buy, ` + full name + `level` + `plus X percent income` / `plus less than 1 percent income` / `plus Δ per tap`.
- **`bestBuyMark(pick)`** is the one source for the strip ★ **and** the chip. It returns the shared best_roi pick (the DualPicker hint, i.e. bundle payback) when that pick is affordable (D-PMFU-05, F4-13).
- **`next-goal.ts`:** with M4 on, HENS / VALUE / COLL goals carry `parts`. The flag-off AC5 labels and aria stay byte-identical.
- **`app.ts` + CSS:**
  - The strip renders `.ng-star` / `.ng-name` / `.ng-lv` / `.ng-sfx`.
  - Only `.ng-name` can ellipsise. The other spans are `flex:none; white-space:nowrap`, and the whole-label ellipsis is gone for the F4 strip.
  - The UX-M4 chip is `★ Best buy`: #F2B233 background, `--c-text` label at 7.0:1, ★ aria-hidden. It sits on the one Farm / Hens / Egg value / Collection row that `bestBuyMark` names, and never on a capped row.
  - The upgrade rows now render after the shared pick is refreshed, so the outline, chip and ★ all use the same frame's pick (before this, the outline lagged one frame).

### ACs → tests
| AC | Test |
|---|---|
| F4-1..6 templates + truncation order, F4-6 ellipsis = 27 | `m41-8-f4-label` "F4 templates and truncation" |
| NBSP placement | "NBSP before L{n} and either side of ·" |
| F4-7 length property | "F4-7 length property": Hens / Egg value / Collection × levels **0..maxLevel and 0..55** × X ∈ {hidden, <1, 1, 9, 10, 99, 100, 999} × milestone × ★ (>2000 labels). Level + suffix are intact and the aria has no `…` / `★` / short name. Plus real states on shipped data via `selectGoal` |
| F4-8 milestone variant + Farm gate | "F4-8 milestone variant" |
| F4-9 / 9b / 10 / 11 + boundaries **0, 0.5 %, 1 %** (and 0.999, negative, income 0) | "F4-9 floor / F4-9b float edge / boundaries…" |
| F4-12 X == best_roi delta | "F4-12 one calculation": a grid of real states. X == `floor(100·optionGain.gain / incomePerSec + 1e-9)`, and the rendered strip contains that X |
| F4-13 ★ rule / one source with the chip | "F4-13 ★ rule" + `m41-8-best-chip`. In jsdom, for picks HENS / VALUE / COLL / FARM: exactly one chip, on that row, and the strip aria says `best buy` for the same target. None when broke. The chip moves on purchase |
| F4-14 aria | "F4-14 aria" + `goalAria` sentence |
| F4-16 Collection | "F4-16 Collection" |
| F4-17 360, suffix never cut, 3 engines | `scripts/m41-8-shots.mjs` (below) |
| F4-18 no `Egg val.` in src | "F4-18" |
| F4-19 | No Max-for-this-farm row on main (that's #60). Here: "a capped row never carries the chip" + best_roi excludes locked rows |
| F4-15 toasts / hints unchanged | existing `m4a-tracks-ui` tests unchanged and passing |
| UX-M4 chip on exactly one row, moves on purchase, ★ glyph | `m41-8-best-chip` + shots |
| F4-20..25 | N/A (D-HOP-42, L30+) |

### Local gates @ `fcf98235545359c56313235a31d73ff3bd3154a1` (committed scripts only, no env overrides)
- `tsc --noEmit`: PASS
- `vitest run --minWorkers=1 --maxWorkers=2`: PASS, 1005/1005
- `npm run build` + check-release-build: PASS (`m3-rc1-pre+fcf9823 ok`)
- `npm run build:html` + check-release-build: PASS (`build id m3-rc1-pre+fcf9823 matches HEAD ok`)
- `check-globals` (Chromium, `flock /workspace/egg-farm-studio/.browser-test.lock timeout 600`): PASS 3/3
- `sync-economy --check`: PASS
- **360 shots:** `npm run build:qa && node scripts/m41-8-shots.mjs <engine> /workspace/wt-ui-shots/m41-8-fcf9823`, one engine at a time, each inside lane-1 `flock … timeout 600`.
  - Chromium, Firefox and WebKit each pass 23/23 checks.
  - Real states: Hens %, Egg value % at exactly 27, Egg value milestone, Hens milestone, Collection, and broke (no ★ / no chip). Each has a strip shot and a chip shot.
  - The five F4-17 worst-case strings, measured as suffix/level fully visible inside the pill.
  - Output: 54 PNGs + README + `checks-<engine>.txt` in `/workspace/wt-ui-shots/m41-8-fcf9823/`.

### Spec conflicts (files followed; please confirm)
1. **NBSP:** the art file says "NBSP between `L` and `{n}`". m4a-spec v1.24 / D-PMFU-01 says NBSP **before** `L{n}`, with no space inside `L30`. All the 27-character counts in both files only work the spec's way, so I followed the spec.
2. **Hidden %:** the art file hides it "only when delta = 0 or income 0". Spec F4-11 / D-PMFU-04 also hides a **negative** delta. I followed the spec, and applied its `+1e-9` floor (F4-9b), which the art file doesn't mention.
3. **Collection Δtap format:** the art file's example is `+1.2K/tap` / "1.2 thousand per tap". Spec F4-16 and the existing template use the raw integer (`+1250/tap`, "plus 5 per tap"). I kept the raw integer.
4. **Chip colour:** UX-M4 says gold #F2B233. rc1-upgrade-value v1.6.1 says `--c-yolk` #FFC93C plus a yolk-dark outline. I used UX-M4 and kept the existing orange `.best` outline.
5. **Chip/★ only when affordable:** UX-M4 says "best … affordable row". rc1 also showed the chip on an unaffordable target. The art file says ★ matches the chip, so with nothing affordable there is no ★ and no chip.
6. **Workers:** the chip is only on Farm / Hens / Egg value / Collection rows. When the best buy is a worker hire, no row carries a chip, and the worker strip labels are unchanged per m3 §2.
7. **F4-17 worst cases** like `★ Egg value L55 · +999% income` can't be reached on shipped data (cap L30). The shot script renders them with the app's CSS into a clone of the live strip. When the name is CSS-ellipsised, a glyph-width gap remains before `L55`. JS truncation means the real strip never hits this case.

Art & UX: please sign off on SHA fcf9823 from the shots above.
title: M4.1 M41-8 F3/F4: next-goal strip label (★ / +X% income, 27-char truncation) + UX-M4 ★ Best buy chip
